question: Gaaffii
defaultDirections: Deebii gaaffii kanaaf deebii ta'a jettee yaaddu fili. Yeroo xumurte, {checkAnswer} tuqi. Sirrummaa deebii keetii fi akkamitti itti fufuu akka qabdu kan agarsiisu duub deebii ni argatta.
relatedContentDescription: Kun qabiyyee gaaffii kana wajjin walqabatuuf bakka cufamaa uuma, yeroo hundas ni mul'ata
hintDescription: Kun yoo fayyadamaan deebii dogoggore ni dhiyaata
evidenceDescription: Kun yoo fayyadamaan deebii sirrii argate ni dhiyaata
flagDirections: Alaabaa tokko filadhu, achiis {unit} ykn fakkii barreeffama keessaa ragaa isaaf ta'e hunda filadhu. Alaabaa balleessuuf qarqara irratti filadhu. Yeroo xumurte, {checkAnswer} tuqi.
selectOneDirections: {unit} gaaffii sana akka gaariitti deebisu filadhu, achiis {checkAnswer} tuqi.
holding: {flag} qabatteetta. Iddoo itti argamu filadhu. Escape deebisee kaa'a.
pickAFlag: Alaabaa tokko filadhu, achiis iddoo itti argamu filadhu.
editHint: Barreeffama armaan gadii gulaali. Iddoo alaabaan hundi itti argamu filachuuf baafata cufaa keessatti Deebii mallatteessi fayyadami.
markingHint: Deebii mallatteessaa jira: alaabaa tokko filadhu, achiis iddoo inni itti argamu hunda filadhu. Barattoonni sadarkaa kana gonkumaa hin argan.
noTargets: Barreeffama keeyyata ykn fakkii qabu cufaa kana irratti dabali.
